goal: Implement the 10 Nexus upgrade spaces (semantic memory, overnight daemon, CRDT state, learned router, machine reviewers, dashboard, bridge security, LoRA fine-tuning, observability, containerized loop) without scope overlap

tasks.task: Upgrade Space 1 - Semantic memory for coordination: embed agent_memory_store chunks via existing EmbeddingProvider port, store vectors alongside chunks, hybrid score = alpha*cosine + (1-alpha)*TF-IDF with TF-IDF fallback when embedder unavailable; wire scripts/memory_comm.py query path through it
acceptance: pytest tests/integration/test_memory_semantic.py -q passes
hybrid scoring demonstrably beats TF-IDF-only on a paraphrase pair (CI red vs build failure)
no new env vars introduced (uses existing EmbeddingProvider config)

tasks.task: Upgrade Space 3 - Swarm state as real CRDTs: port conflux/ CRDT concepts into src/nexus/domain/crdt/ (G-Counter heartbeats, LWW-Register task status with tick+agent tie-break, OR-Set task membership), add SwarmStatePort, merge-on-read with state_hash, integrate into scripts/agent_comm.py
acceptance: pytest tests/unit/test_crdt.py -q passes
merge is commutative and idempotent: same action set from any write order produces identical state_hash
no import from nexus.infrastructure anywhere in the new domain code

tasks.task: Upgrade Space 7 - Bridge security hardening: shared-token auth on connect (NEXUS_BRIDGE_TOKEN), op allowlist (default allow: ping, open; run/edit opt-in), per-op rate limit, audit log into agent memory store; document the new vars in the ops table of docs/architecture-map.md in the SAME commit (guard test_docs_env_vars.py bites otherwise)
acceptance: pytest tests/integration/test_bridge_security.py -q passes
unauthenticated connect rejected without token; run/edit denied by default allowlist
all new NEXUS_* vars documented in docs/architecture-map.md in the same diff

tasks.task: Upgrade Space 2 - Full overnight autonomy daemon: one daemon tying bridge events + task queue -> heal -> consensus -> apply (CEO-approved only) -> verify -> commit -> dream cycle, with budget-aware scheduling via TokenBudgetMiddleware, blackout windows, and a kill-switch file
acceptance: pytest tests/eval/test_overnight_daemon.py -q passes
daemon stops on kill-switch file and respects blackout windows
no patch applies without consensus verdict

tasks.task: Upgrade Space 5 - Automated first-pass consensus reviewers: attach ruff/mypy/import-linter results as evidence on propose, add bandit security scan as a mandatory reviewer, enforce tests-required rule (patch touching src/ without tests/ is auto-request_changes)
acceptance: pytest tests/integration/test_consensus_reviewers.py -q passes
a src-only patch is auto-request_changes without any human review
deterministic verdict order preserved

tasks.task: Upgrade Space 4 - Learned model router: train a small classifier on route_log + accepted-answer outcomes, feed answer quality back from the eval harness, add latency-x-quality cost-aware routing and speculative short-circuit for the local tier
acceptance: pytest tests/integration/test_routing_provider.py -q passes
existing routing tests show no regression
router persists learned weights across restarts

tasks.task: Upgrade Space 8 - Offline LoRA fine-tuning on approved work: pipeline on RTX 3050 using consensus-approved patches as preference pairs (approved=good, rejected=bad), golden-set eval as regression gate before swapping a local model, CLI entry in src/nexus/training/cli.py
acceptance: pytest tests/eval/test_lora_pipeline.py -q passes
model swap is blocked when golden-set pass rate regresses
pipeline reads only consensus-approved/rejected pairs from the memory store

tasks.task: Upgrade Space 6 - Real-time swarm dashboard: Vite page over the WebSocket bridge showing live agents, task queue, consensus votes awaiting CEO, token budgets burning, heal iterations; bridge already pushes all needed events
acceptance: npm run build passes in web/
npm run lint passes in web/
dashboard renders live agent status from bridge events without polling

tasks.task: Upgrade Space 9 - Agent-layer observability: OpenTelemetry spans for heal iterations and consensus rounds via existing Metrics/Tracer ports, Prometheus counters for route hit-rates, heal success rate, consensus latency, token spend per agent
acceptance: pytest tests/integration/test_agent_telemetry.py -q passes
counters exposed at the metrics endpoint
spans emitted only when NEXUS_OTEL_ENABLED=true (zero overhead disabled)

tasks.task: Upgrade Space 10 - Containerized full loop: docker-compose profile for the whole autonomous loop (bridge + heal daemon + ceo loop) with agent memory store as a mounted volume, reusing the runtime lockfile
acceptance: docker compose -f docker-compose.loop.yml config parses without error (validate via python -c yaml if docker absent locally)
profile installs only requirements.txt
new compose vars listed in .env.example

tasks.task: Upgrade-space docs: record all 10 landed upgrade spaces in docs/ (upgrade-spaces page + index.md link + AGENTS.md notes) after the code tasks land; include env vars, ports, and how to enable each
acceptance: pytest tests/eval/test_docs_integrity.py -q passes
no dead links or anchors from the new page
every env var introduced by tasks 1-10 is documented (guard test_docs_env_vars.py passes)
